text: MediaMarkt is a brand of Media-Saturn-Holding (MediaMarktSaturn Retail Group), headquartered in Ingolstadt, which bundles business under the MediaMarkt and Saturn brands and is part of Ceconomy AG. Ceconomy AG is a publicly traded company listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (FWB: CEC, SDAX component); in July 2025 JD.com agreed to acquire Ceconomy for about 2.2 billion euros.
short: MediaMarkt is a Media-Saturn brand; Media-Saturn is part of listed Ceconomy AG.
